label: Bible Study
prompt: I will heal their _____, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
verse: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
note: The last chapter of Hosea — after all the heartbreak, God promises to love freely.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively _____ by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
verse: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
note: Peter blesses God for a 'lively hope' — a living one, born out of an empty tomb.

label: Sunday School
prompt: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, _____ to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;
verse: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;
note: Raised as royalty, Moses refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter and stood with his own people.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Elias was a man subject to like _____ as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
verse: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
note: Elias (Elijah) was made of the same clay as us, James insists — yet his prayer shut the sky for three and a half years.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For ever, O LORD, thy word is _____ in heaven.
verse: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
note: In a world of revisions, one thing is final: 'For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.'
